claim: Only deterministic ingestion can admit a newly executed observation into the measurement registry. Valid candidate Y is independently established before refusal as evidence for authorised X.

architecture.capture: ArtifactStateEvidence::establish(path) uses the public cold candidate reader. Capture its verified binding with execution and pass it alongside PreparedExperiment and Observed to MeasurementArtifact::from_execution. The immutable artifact seals the candidate binding as well as the original request/observation fields. This is the widening preregistered in OPT6-N2, not another state identity input.
architecture.validate: validate and ingest require the existing VerifiedFacts::complete contract after checking the artifact seal, then reopen persisted source, candidate and corpus inputs. They check the request and artifact keys, self-check protocol declarations, resolve the declared procedure and gate, compare source and candidate authority, verify bank manifest and payloads, and check observation shape and reported position/gate consistency. Candidate reading receives no requested state. Completeness is necessary; it does not independently prove the executor's historical checks.
architecture.commit: ingest validates before cloning facts, then records into the cloned registry. Only a successful new record replaces the snapshot. All other scientific facts and configuration remain identical. Identical observations are idempotent, including after selection has changed; conflicts preserve the prior snapshot and return typed key/expected/observed evidence.
architecture.boundary: AcceptedMeasurement has private fields and no Deserialize implementation. Production MeasurementRegistry::record requires this token and is scoped to REPRESENT. Raw record_fixture is compiled only for tests/test-utils. Snapshot restoration remains the existing authoritative scientific-state loading path; MeasurementArtifact deserialization grants no acceptance.
architecture.closure: tests/ingestion_closure.rs parses every non-test Rust source under crates/*/src, including other platforms. The exact file/function/call census also registers unrelated record methods so aliases cannot evade the scan by changing receiver names. Its positive control finds the actual ingestion call; hostile controls detect new owners, associated-function references and macro calls. Rust type/visibility restrictions independently prevent raw registry writes.

xy_transaction: The artifact carries requested key X and the executor restates X. The candidate independently establishes valid Y, and the artifact carries Y's genuinely verified binding. Ingestion refuses specifically at candidate representation state, naming both IDs. The test compares the entire snapshot, serialized bytes, next selection, frontier and promotion output before/after.

limits: This validates experiment identity and persisted input integrity. It does not independently reproduce the numerical observation or turn executor-reported runtime pointer/attribution checks into independent facts; those reports are not used as identity authority.
Accepted evidence is an observation, not a passing gate result or promotion. The existing gate/ranking/promotion code interprets it downstream.

The fixture uses real graph-based encoded/compiled candidates and sealed tiny input rows with deterministic synthetic observations. It does not claim a Kimi/K3 execution or numerical accuracy experiment.
SOURCE-AUTHORITY-MANIFEST-1 remains the separate inherited moe_manifest-content debt. No source or representation canonicalization/version changes were made.
